notes.title: Developer complete walkthrough - Hard and standard mode - Good and bad ending
notes.notes:
I released two complete walkthrough on Youtube.

The first video is a complete walktrough in hard mode with the bad ending, the other one was completed in standard mode with the good ending.

If you haven't managed to escape from the labyrinth yet, these videos are for you: "my sinners still locked in the labyrinth" :)

Please, if you've played the game leave me a review on Steam, I need it, I'd appreciate a lot.
Thank you very much  :)

notes.title: SPEEDRUN EVENT
notes.notes:
Test yourself with other players. 
Face the creature, solve the puzzles, complete your game run as soon as possible and try to get to the top of the [url=https://www.speedrun.com/the_ancient_labyrinth]leaderboard[/url]. 
Will you be the fastest player to escape from the maze?


The game was posted on speedrun.com by the user SilentProtagonist who also completed his speedrun: https://www.speedrun.com/the_ancient_labyrinth/run/z018n6oy.
Thank you very much SilentProtagonist.

notes.title: SAVE SYSTEM
notes.notes:
The new update has been released that allows you to save game progress in safe areas of the map for easy and standard difficulties. 
For the most fearless the hard difficulty remained unchanged, with no possibility of saving progress. 
After completing the game share your results on the community and your opinions about the lore of the game. 
What is the maze really?
What is the significance of those strange events that have occurred? 
What connection exists with the ancient egyptians?

notes.title: Important game balances
notes.notes: Important game balances have been made to the game: a minor difficulty in the "challenge" with the monster, addition of new safe areas where to hide from the creature, greater stamina in the run, higher frame rate for some graphic settings.

notes.title: First walkthrough (not complete) on Youtube
notes.notes:
Bilom radpie 100 shared his game walkthrough on Youtube (not with the maximum graphic settings).
He played exactly how I would like all the other players to play it: with calm and attention to the surrounding environment to find the key objects, he tried to escape from the monster by hiding in the darkness.

Thank you very much Bilom radpie 100.
[previewyoutube=4OuFExCHG9s;full][/previewyoutube]

Soon I will publish my first complete walkthrough with maximum graphic settings.

notes.title: Survival tips guide and rank system guide added
notes.notes: Two guides have been added to the community hub, one with suggestions for surviving the maze and another with information on the rank system.

notes.title: The Ancient Labyrinth is available now !!! Share your result with the community
notes.notes: The Ancient Labyrinth is available now !!! Explore the maze, solve puzzles and survive the dangerous creature hidden in the darkness. If you manage to escape from the maze (and after facing your destiny) share your result with the other members of the community in the discussion that will be created soon. Who will manage to escape from the labyrinth as quickly as possible?

notes.title: Rank system
notes.notes: Rank system added at the end of the game. This way your results can be compared with those of other users.
